name: pagerduty
summary: PagerDuty's hosted MCP server (incidents, services, schedules, on-call) with your own OAuth app
notes: Create an OAuth app in PagerDuty first (Integrations, App Registration; Scoped OAuth needs an account admin). PagerDuty does not register clients itself. Register the redirect URL http://localhost:8977/callback.

Scopes: this template asks only for read, so the manage_* tools will be refused by PagerDuty. Add write to connect.scopes (and to the app) when you want changes. The hosted server cannot filter tools; the app's scopes are the limit.

Asks first (consent): manage_incidents (creating or changing an incident pages people), manage_teams and manage_alert_grouping (both include delete), manage_status_pages (posts publicly). manage_services, manage_schedules and manage_event_orchestrations are ordinary writes.
EU accounts: change connect.url to https://mcp.eu.pagerduty.com/mcp and the hosts accordingly (the EU OAuth hosts were not researched).
Needs a PagerDuty account with Advanced Permissions.

Headless alternative: a User API key, which PagerDuty wants as 'Authorization: Token token=KEY'. That is the mcp-http-key archetype with connect.auth_scheme "prefix", connect.auth_prefix "Token token=" and credential_ref store:pagerduty-api-key (same url and mcp.pagerduty.com host); this template stays OAuth.
The browse_* tools take an action argument, so no smoke op is set.
